fonts.instantiation: fonttools varLib.instancer wght=400 --update-name-table; Windows and Macintosh name IDs 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 16, 17 and 25 set to the project-unique HB Manual Sans JP (OTF) identity; PANOSE bWeight set from usWeightClass (350->3 Light, 400->5 Book, 500->6 Medium, 700->8 Bold) because varLib.instancer carries the variable font's OS/2 through unchanged, leaving every instance at 2 (Very Light) and contradicting its own style bits
